name: Timemore Sculptor 064
details: Electric single-dose grinder with 64 mm flat burrs and a stepless dial (the original, non-S model).

notes.turkish: Honest Coffee Guide lists no Turkish range.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): espresso 0, moka pot 0–5, AeroPress 0–10.5, V60 1–5.5, filter coffee machine 0–9.5, French press 6–16, cold brew 8–16; Turkish N/A. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion. For the stock burrs.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
